questions.q: What two great powers clashed and flanked Makkah?
questions.explain: Makkah sat between the clashing Rome and Persia.

questions.q: The term Yahudi comes from the name of which son of Prophet Ya'qub?
questions.explain: From the name Yahuda comes the term Yahudi (Jew).

questions.q: About how old was the ghulam in this story?
questions.explain: A ghulam is a boy of about 13 to 19, like a lower-secondary student.

questions.q: Who was the rahib in this story?
options: A follower of Prophet Isa AS who still held to tawhid
questions.explain: The rahib secretly taught the ghulam tawhid.

questions.q: What was the dabbah in this story?
options: A large four-legged beast blocking the road
questions.explain: The ghulam removed the beast out of concern for the public.

questions.q: What does Burj mean in the name Surah Al-Buruj?
questions.explain: Burj evokes Allah, who records every deed.

questions.q: From whom did Abraha seize power in Yemen?
questions.explain: Abraha was a general of Aryat who seized power, and his story continues into Ashab al-Fil.

questions.q: The rahib taught a simple tawhid: worship Allah with no intermediaries.
questions.explain: True. Humans are not gods and there is no intermediary.

questions.q: The ghulam accepted the minister's expensive gift as payment for the cure.
questions.explain: False. The ghulam refused the gift because his aim was to guide people to faith.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The people believe in the ghulam's Lord
The rahib and minister are killed

questions.explain: Rome and Persia clashed, the Jews went to Yathrib, the rahib and minister were killed, the people believed, and Abraha took over Yemen.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Man's original nature that recognises the truth
Reality appearing as A but actually B
Those who dug the trench and burned believers

questions.explain: Sihr is hidden reality, fitrah is the original state, tawriyah is a two-meaning phrase, and Ashabul Ukhdud are the trench-diggers.

questions.q: The people who died in this story seemed to have failed. What is the lesson about success?
options: Success is measured by Allah's perspective
questions.explain: Allah changes the perspective by calling them the successful ones.
